queries.question: Why can an all-soluble all-iron flow-battery architecture decouple energy and power more completely than an iron deposition-type architecture?

queries.reference_answer: Keeping both iron redox couples soluble allows energy to scale with external electrolyte volume while power scales with cell area; deposition-type systems are additionally constrained by plated-metal area, morphology and areal capacity.
